page.overview:
What is Anthony Goldstein?

Anthony Goldstein (b. c. 1979/1980) was a half-blood wizard who began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1991. He was Sorted into Ravenclaw house. In his fifth year, he was selected as one of his House's Prefects. He also joined Dumbledore's Army, an organisation taught and led by Harry Potter.

He later fought in the Battle of Hogwarts in 1998. Anthony survived the final battle of the Second Wizarding War and graduated from school. He was most likely present for Harry Potter's final defeat of Lord Voldemort.

Anthony was born into the Jewish Goldstein family. He had at least one magical parent and was distantly related to Porpentina and Queenie Goldstein.

In 1991, Anthony began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. He was in the same class as the famous Harry Potter. He was sorted into Ravenclaw house, which values wit and creativity. He befriended dorm-mates Terry Boot and Michael Corner, and was also on speaking terms with Ernest Macmillan.
